tools.name: host_zip
tools.description:
Upload a zipped bundle of files to a hosted site in a single call.
Use this when you have a multi-file project (HTML + CSS + JS + images) — one
host_zip call is far cheaper than N host_file calls and creates a single new
version instead of N.

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: build_website, get_site_status · Private data: build_website, host_site, host_file, get_hosted_files, host_zip · Public sink: build_website, host_file, host_zip · Destructive: build_website.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: build_website, get_site_status · Private data: build_website, host_site, host_file, get_hosted_files, host_zip · Public sink: build_website, host_file, host_zip · Destructive: build_website

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
